newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Business slow in short week.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Business slow in short week.

text.p: U.S. spot millfeed prices were mostly steady Wednesday but dealers noted some logistical problems due to an abbreviated Thanksgiving holiday week.

"Logistics is the word today," a St Louis dealer said. "Mostly everyone is running through today (Wednesday). It will be really interesting to see what Monday brings, because I think people have fallen behind in shipments, at least in the St Louis market anyway."
He added that the market has a firmer tone.
"We are trying to get through the logistical headaches," another dealer said.

The basic reason is that all the feed mills are running everyday except Thursday (Thanksgiving) but most flour mills go down on Wednesday night and they usually do not go back up until Sunday night, he said.
Some trucks have to load earlier and hold them (midds) over on Thanksgiving and deliver millfeed on Friday, he noted.
